events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Patron of Weavers (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_SILK] Silk, Dye, and [ICON_RES_COTTON] Cotton resource)
The Shoshone have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

Babylon has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)

Indonesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
The Inca have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Forge (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in every city)

Portugal has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Seafood Rituals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each source of [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crabs, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CAVIAR] Black Caviar and [ICON_RES_REDCAVIAR] Red Caviar. +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from each source of [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish)
